hints.title: Whole Array Bitwise Sum
hints.text: Calculate the bitwise exclusive-or sum of the entire array. If it is already non-zero, the answer is the full length.

hints.title: Zero Sum Inversion
hints.text: If the full bitwise sum is zero, removing any single non-zero element leaves a non-zero sum because zero exclusive-or x equals x.

hints.title: All Zeros Edge Case
hints.text: If every single element is zero, no subsequence can have a non-zero sum, so return zero.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass reduction using bitwise exclusive-or properties.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all 2^N subsequences results in exponential time complexity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that removing one non-zero element from a zero-sum set yields that non-zero element.
